_note: Run: .venvs/27_ibot/bin/python bin/mutate.py --spec mutations/27_ibot-step1-device.json --python .venvs/27_ibot/bin/python (an interpreter with 27_ibot's lock and a CUDA device). Proves the device guard added during the port is not vacuous: the captured trainer called .cuda(local_rank) on the model, the loss and every crop unconditionally, so it could not start without a GPU, and honouring `device: cpu` on a GPU machine is a real behaviour the resolve_device change added. Kept in the repository because a mutation result that lives only in a chat message cannot be checked by anyone later. See docs/GPU.md section 4.

targets.label: cpu is not honoured -- the requested cpu returns a cuda device
cuda without a gpu is no longer refused, it falls back silently
the crops ignore the resolved device and go to the GPU regardless
targets.old: crops = [c.to(device, non_blocking=True) for c in crops]
targets.new: crops = [c.cuda(0, non_blocking=True) for c in crops]
